title: Validity Formula Cost
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The cost of the validity CNF is at most $\bigl(3(|\mathrm{State}(M)|+1)^2+(|\mathrm{State}(M)|+1)+9+21k\bigr)(s+n+2)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
